note: What the accepted build (949da67) needs besides this package. 'download' files are fetched by fetch-assets.sh and must equal the size and SHA-256 given here; a file that differs is never used. 'build' items are made on the device. 'pinned_by_accepted_build' is what the default admission compares at startup with the reference device's records: read it before building anything. The opt-in device-artifacts route (experimental validation runs only) compares the same files with a record of this device's own instead, and needs the build items made by this package's own scripts with the settings given here (QUICKSTART.md, section 1).
